name: buddy
description: Buddy is back: the retired /buddy terminal companion as a Claude Code mod, with new sprites and Haiku writing its lines.

mode.title: Seed mode
mode.description: hatch: your buddy comes from your account id, as the original /buddy did. pick: choose it by hand with /buddy pick <species> [rarity] [eyes] [hat] [shiny].

model.title: Buddy model
model.description: The model that writes the buddy's lines (its name and personality, reactions, pet replies and answers when you call it by name). An alias such as haiku or a full model id. Never the session's main model.

cooldown_seconds.title: Reaction cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum time between reaction calls. The original used 30.
